# Actual CSS

> Plain CSS component framework for new projects: semantic classes, shared variants, small tokens, themes, and progressive enhancement.

Actual CSS uses a small public grammar: `.component [intent] [variant] [size] [modifier]`. It claims unprefixed class names by design. Existing projects with collisions should use cascade layers, import order, or an application-side prefix transform.

## Core Documentation & Guides

- [README](README.md): Install, imports, public class grammar, browser support, and distribution notes.
- [Mental Model](docs/mental-model.md): How components, intents, variants, tokens, and runtime enhancers fit together.
- [Tokens](docs/tokens.md): Theme contract and public token surface.
- [Components](docs/components.md): Component markup and composition examples.
- [Forms](docs/forms.md): Field layout, controls, labels, validation, and form actions.
- [UI](docs/ui.md): JavaScript-enhanced UI patterns.

## Design & Maintenance

- [Why Actual CSS](docs/why.md): Positioning, tradeoffs, and non-goals.
- [Accessibility](docs/accessibility.md): Guarantees, tested behavior, and author responsibilities.
- [Guidelines](docs/guidelines.md): Contributor rules and implementation constraints.

## Package Entrypoints

- CSS: `actual-css`, `actual-css/css`, `actual-css/css/layer`, `actual-css/css/components`, `actual-css/css/forms`, `actual-css/css/ui`.
- Optional CSS: `actual-css/css/optional/typography-fluid`, `actual-css/css/optional/scroller`.
- JavaScript: `actual-css/js`, plus individual enhancers such as `actual-css/js/dialog`, `actual-css/js/flyout`, `actual-css/js/tooltip`, `actual-css/js/tab`, `actual-css/js/inputmode`, and `actual-css/js/mask`.
